purpose: Small public data intake and format pilot, not a representative benchmark or held-out test set.
limitations: The samples are source-order selections, not random or balanced.
English financial QA and Korean general-domain relation extraction must not be pooled into a Zoop accuracy score.
Gold is kept separate from model-visible files; both are development material already inspected by the author.
Existing zoop_eval score commands do not accept these external dataset shapes.
